# Summit Revenue Recovery System

> This page is the roofing-focused conversion offer for Summit Voice AI (summitvoiceai.com),
> built and operated by Summit Marketing Group, founded by Dan Gill. It exists to get a
> roofing company owner to book a free "Revenue Leak Audit." The core premise: before a
> roofing company spends more money generating new leads, it should find out how many
> opportunities it already paid for are leaking out through missed calls, slow follow-up,
> cold estimates, and a dead CRM database.

## Core message

"Before you spend another dollar generating opportunities, let's make sure you're
monetizing the ones you've already paid for."

## The Revenue Recovery Loop

Capture → Respond → Follow Up → Reactivate → Book → Review → Optimize. This 7-step loop is
the mechanism the Summit Revenue Recovery System automates end-to-end using Ava (the AI
voice receptionist), SMS/email nurture, a database reactivation program, and a review
generation workflow — all wired into the client's existing CRM and calendar.

## Who this is for

Roofing contractors and roofing company owners in the United States who are already
spending money to generate leads (ads, referrals, storm work) and want to know how much of
that spend is being wasted through missed calls, slow response, no follow-up on estimates,
and old CRM leads nobody is working. Summit Voice AI also serves home services, real
estate, healthcare, legal, and other appointment-driven businesses — this specific page is
built for roofing.

## Offer and pricing

The flagship offer is the Summit Revenue Recovery System™: $1,497/month + $3,000
one-time implementation (annual prepay: $16,500 + implementation). Two adjacent tiers:
SummitVoice AI Capture™ ($697/month + $1,500 implementation, entry-level) and Summit AI
Growth Engine™ ($2,497/month + $5,000 implementation, enterprise/multi-location). Full
tier details: https://revenuerecovery.summitvoiceai.com/#pricing

## Documented results referenced on this page

- Teo Roofing: 582 appointments booked in 12 months via Ava. At a 55% close rate averaging
  $13,100/job, that is $4,190,400+ in recovered revenue.
- A roofing database reactivation campaign of ~4,000 existing leads produced ~294
  appointments and ~$200,000 in attributable reported revenue.
- 42+ active roofing/home-service companies on the platform; $84M+ in client revenue
  recovered annually across active clients; 100% call answer rate, under 1 second.

All ROI figures shown in this page's calculator are hypothetical, illustrative estimates
based on user-entered inputs — not guarantees of revenue, leads, or appointments.

## Implementation guarantee

If the client completes onboarding, provides required access, and meets agreed
prerequisites, and Summit has not deployed the agreed infrastructure within 30 days, Summit
continues implementation at no management fee until the system is live. If after 60 days
Summit cannot point to measurable recovered conversations, appointments, opportunities, or
documented follow-up improvements, Summit will personally review the account and build an
additional recovery campaign at Summit's cost. This is a deployment guarantee, not a
guarantee of leads, appointments, sales, or revenue.
